game.title: Lightkeeper
upg.net.name: Net
upg.net.desc: Catches what drifts by and drops it in the chest. Mend it to catch faster.
upg.storage.name: Storage chest
upg.storage.desc: The net fills this up; tap the chest to take it all. Mend it to hold more.
offline.title: When the tide went out
save.corrupt: The old save couldn't be read, so the lighthouse starts anew. The old save was kept aside.
chest.label: Storage chest, tap to collect
offline.chestFull: The chest filled up, and there was no room for the rest.
debug.resetConfirm: Wipe the test save and start over? (Your real save is untouched.)
upg.light.name: Lighthouse
upg.light.desc: Mend the lighthouse so its light reaches farther.
upg.light.next.dock: Next: repair the dock and build a boat.
upg.light.next.reach: Next: the light reaches farther out to sea.
upg.light.next.glow: Needs glowshards, found only on Firefly Isle.
upg.speed.name: Speed
upg.cargo.name: Cargo hold
upg.cargo.desc: Bring back more from every trip.
map.title: Sea chart
map.locked: Mend the lighthouse to level 3 to repair the dock and build a boat.
map.buildDesc: The dock is ready. Build a small boat and see what the light can reach.
map.unknownDesc: The light has only just reached it. Go and see.
map.dark: The light doesn't reach here yet.
map.away: The boat is on its way to {name}, {time} to go.
map.waiting: The boat is back. Tap it at the dock to unload.
map.pick: Tap a lit spot on the chart to choose where to go.
dest.wreck.name: Wreck Reef
dest.wreck.desc: An old ship ran aground here. Its hold is still full of scrap metal.
dest.gullrock.name: Gull Rock
dest.gullrock.desc: Seabirds nest here. One followed you home and now keeps an eye on the net.
dest.oldlight.name: The Old Lighthouse
dest.oldlight.desc: Another keeper's lighthouse. Inside, you found their old plans.
dest.firefly.name: Firefly Isle
dest.firefly.desc: At night the whole island glows. Its glowshards make the lighthouse brighter.
dest.firefly.perk: The only place to find glowshards
discover.title: A new island
boat.label: Boat
offline.boat: The boat is back and waiting at the dock to be unloaded.
island.store: Waiting on the island (the boat brings it home next visit):
island.storeEmpty: Nothing waiting on the island yet.
island.pick: Tap a plot or a building.
bld.dismantler.name: Breaking bench
bld.dismantler.desc: Strips the wreck bit by bit, saving up scrap metal.
bld.rack.name: Net rack
bld.rack.desc: Dries old nets from the wreck and twists them into rope.
bld.boatshed.name: Boat shed
bld.boatshed.desc: A place to mend the boat. A well-kept boat sails faster.
bld.nest.name: Gull house
bld.nest.desc: A home for the gulls. They bring back bottles from the sea.
bld.kelp.name: Kelp frame
bld.kelp.desc: Dries kelp to twist into strong rope.
bld.lookout.name: Lookout
bld.lookout.desc: From up high the gulls spot drift early and steer it toward your net.
bld.depot.name: Old depot
bld.depot.desc: The other keeper's store. There is still timber inside.
bld.workshop.name: Workshop
bld.workshop.desc: A mended forge turns scrap into useful parts.
bld.desk.name: Keeper's desk
bld.desk.desc: Their notes teach you thriftier ways to mend the lighthouse.
bld.jars.name: Firefly jars
bld.jars.desc: The fireflies leave a little light in each jar, slowly gathering into glowshards.
bld.orchard.name: Orchard
bld.orchard.desc: The island's trees grow well; prunings make good timber.
bld.path.name: Glowing path
bld.path.desc: A path of light to find your way home at night. The chest holds more.
pass.title: Pass the light on
pass.text: The lighthouse is mended and {from} is lit. You can leave it to the wind and the gulls, and go light another lighthouse on {to}.
pass.keep: This sea will stay lit: the net and the island buildings keep working, and you can come back any time.
pass.gain: You will gain {n} starlight ✦. Each one adds 3% to everything you produce, for good.
toast.allLit: Every sea is lit. Thank you, lightkeeper.
dest.fog.wreck.name: Fogbound Wreck
dest.fog.wreck.desc: A great ship looms in and out of the fog. The iron in its hold hasn't rusted yet.
dest.fog.gullrock.name: Mistgull Rock
dest.fog.gullrock.desc: Gull cries sound close in the fog. One knows the lighthouse and followed you home.
dest.fog.oldlight.name: The Silent Lighthouse
dest.fog.oldlight.desc: This lighthouse has been dark a long time. A keeper's log lies open on the desk.
dest.fog.firefly.name: Phosphor Isle
dest.fog.firefly.desc: Waves break in faint blue light. Here, that light gathers into glowshards.
dest.aurora.wreck.name: Icebound Hulk
dest.aurora.wreck.desc: A whole ship frozen into the ice. Break it open and there's metal to salvage.
dest.aurora.gullrock.name: Snowgull Cliff
dest.aurora.gullrock.desc: White gulls crowd the snowy cliff. They're happy to watch your net.
dest.aurora.oldlight.name: The Aurora Light
dest.aurora.oldlight.desc: The northernmost lighthouse of the old stories. Its light is the colour of the aurora.
dest.aurora.firefly.name: Icefly Grotto
dest.aurora.firefly.desc: Deep in the ice cave, small glowing creatures stay awake all winter.
